digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified Gate (gerrit-verify.yaml), mutation job workflow
propositions: When a mutation job is cancelled or times out, gerrit-verify.yaml casts Verified -1 with a message of exactly 'CANCELLED: <run URL>' that names no job and gives no reason, forcing manual triage

A timeout (mutation job exceeds timeout-minutes: 30) and a stale-base version skew (selector step fails with 'invalid choice') both produce identical uninformative 'CANCELLED:' votes, preventing triage agents from distinguishing which requires author action
gerrit-review-action hardcodes MESSAGE='${STATUS}: ${SERVER_URL}/...' with no input for custom text, so the detail cannot be enriched in the vote message itself

A new summarize_ci_failures.py script maps GitHub job lists and check-run annotations to triage-friendly one-line summaries (job name, TIMED OUT vs CANCELLED vs FAILED, duration, url), returning empty string when all jobs succeed

Two new workflow steps in gerrit-verify.yaml post triage detail as a comment-only SSH gerrit review --message call (no label cast) after the vote is already cast, guarded on vote-type != success and continue-on-error to prevent vote redding on failure
